titulo: Rituximab and Combination Chemotherapy in Treating Patients With Diffuse Large B-Cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma

braco.texto:
Patients receive the following treatment:

Cycle 1 Doses:

* Rituximab 375 mg/m\^2 IV infusion on Day 1 prior to EPOCH chemotherapy
* Doxorubicin 10 mg/m\^2/day CIVI on Days 1-4
* Etoposide 50 mg/m\^2/day CIVI on Days 1-4
* Vincristine 0.4 mg/m\^2/day (no cap) CIVI on Days 1-4 (total 1.6 mg/m2 over 96 hours)
* Cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m\^2 IV on Day 5 (following completion of 96 hour infusions)
* Prednisone 60 mg/m\^2
braco.textoPt:
Os pacientes recebem o seguinte tratamento:

Doses do Ciclo 1:

* Infusão IV de rituximabe 375 mg/m\^2 no dia 1 antes da quimioterapia ÉPOCA
* Doxorrubicina 10 mg/m\^2/dia CIVI nos Dias 1-4
* Etoposídeo 50 mg/m\^2/dia CIVI nos Dias 1-4
* Vincristina 0,4 mg/m\^2/dia (sem tampa) CIVI nos Dias 1-4 (total 1,6 mg/m2 ao longo de 96 horas)
* Ciclofosfamida 750 mg/m\^2 IV no Dia 5 (após a conclusão das infusões de 96 horas)
* Prednisona 60 mg/m\^2

trechos: * Administer filgrastim 480 mcg subcutaneous daily from Day 6 until ANC \> 5000 after the nadir (nadir usually between Days 10-12) or for 10 days (Days 6-15) if the ANC is not being monitored, during every cycle.

titulo: Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Plus Chemotherapy vs Placebo Plus Chemotherapy as Neoadjuvant Therapy and Pembrolizumab vs Placebo as Adjuvant Therapy in Participants With Triple Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) (MK-3475-522/KEYNOTE-522)

braco.texto: Participants receive 200 mg pembrolizumab every 3 weeks (Q3W) + 80 mg/m\^2 paclitaxel weekly + carboplatin (Area Under the Curve \[AUC\]1.5 weekly or AUC5 Q3W) x 4 cycles, followed by 200 mg pembrolizumab Q3W + (60 mg/m\^2 doxorubicin OR 90 mg/m\^2 epirubicin) + 600 mg/m\^2 cyclophosphamide Q3W x 4 cycles as neoadjuvant therapy prior to surgery; followed by 9 cycles of 200 mg pembrolizumab Q3W as adjuvant therapy pos
